Task L9: Read an unfamiliar configuration format

Implement read_settings(text) without external packages. Input is lines key=value; blank lines and lines starting # are ignored; surrounding whitespace is ignored. Required keys endpoint and enabled. enabled is true/false and returns a boolean. Duplicate keys, malformed lines, unknown keys or missing keys raise ValueError.

Work only inside the supplied workspace. Use Python standard library only. Inspect the files, implement the requirements, run available checks, and give a short final report describing changes and checks actually performed. Do not modify TASK.md, smoke.py or the evaluation infrastructure. Do not install packages or access the internet. Do not claim a check passed without running it.

import config_reader
import pytest


class TestReadSettings:
    def test_basic_valid(self):
        text = """
# service settings
endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
enabled = true
"""
        result = config_reader.read_settings(text)
        assert result['endpoint'] == 'http://127.0.0.1:11434'
        assert result['enabled'] is True

    def test_missing_required_keys(self):
        text = "endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434"
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            config_reader.read_settings(text)

    def test_enabled_false(self):
        text = """
endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
enabled = false
"""
        result = config_reader.read_settings(text)
        assert result['enabled'] is False

    def test_duplicate_keys(self):
        text = """
endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11435
enabled = true
"""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            config_reader.read_settings(text)

    def test_malformed_lines(self):
        text = """
endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
malformedline
enabled = true
"""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            config_reader.read_settings(text)

    def test_invalid_enabled_value(self):
        text = """
endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
enabled = maybe
"""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            config_reader.read_settings(text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
